_comment_include_globs: The 27 include_globs that were the ProjectConfig default when M0-M4
acceptance was pinned, frozen here on 2026-09-08. Before that date this
file pinned exclude_globs ONLY, so include_globs fell through to the
live default -- and the coverage widening that same day appended eight
patterns to that default, taking NNG's gap tier from 276 files / 19.60%
of first-party bytes to 0. Acceptance criteria that pin the gap at 276
would have started reporting 0.00% against their own primary corpus,
which reads as the detector losing its discriminating power rather than
as the corpus being fixed. Pinning them here decouples the two: M0-M4
keeps reproducing against the configuration it was measured on while
production config moves on. Do NOT sync these to ProjectConfig.
